author: Bee (Shel)
title: Paid character/concept art for adult fantasy animated series
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I’m a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and I’m looking for artists to help bring it to life! I’m starting small, but this is paid work. I’m looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators—drop your work + rates!! Contact: reply on the post or via Threads @bee.chaoticcore. Follow-up from author (09/13/26): overwhelmed by responses, still early, actively figuring out funding and budgeting, and planning more Threads about the show and team.
